claims: Earth Day is celebrated annually on April 22.
The first Earth Day event occurred in 1970.
Earth Day is the world's largest civic event.
Earth Day engages over a billion people.
The 2025 Earth Day theme is "Our Power, Our Planet".
Earth Day was founded in 1970 by U.S. Senator Gaylord Nelson.
Earth Day was founded after an oil spill in Santa Barbara.
The 1970 Earth Day mobilized 20 million people.
The 1970 Earth Day launched the modern environmental movement.
The 2025/2026 Earth Day theme urges a tripling of global renewable energy generation by 2030.
